verdict.rationale: The 'writing-skills' skill is explicitly described as teaching users to author and test new skills, and skills live as SKILL.md files that are the harness-agnostic source of truth, implying a defined format. However, no evidence explicitly shows a documented frontmatter template (name/description fields) or confirms a new author can build a skill without inspecting existing SKILL.md examples. missing for 10: explicit frontmatter template/spec documentation, evidence that authoring doesn't require reverse-engineering existing skills, independent confirmation of ease of authoring.
